parts.title: Section 2
parts.passageHtml:
{[The Shang Dynasty or Yin Dynasty, according to traditional historiography, ruled in the Yellow River valley in the second millennium BC.][297121]} {[Archaeological work at the Ruins of Yin (near modern-day Anyang), which has been identified as the last Shang capital, uncovered eleven major Yin royal tombs and the foundations of palaces and ritual sites, containing weapons of war and remains from both animal and human sacrifices.][297142]}

{[The Tomb of Fu Hao is an archaeological site at Yinxu, the ruins of the ancient Shang Dynasty capital Yin, within the modern city of Anyang in Henan Province, China.][297189]} {[Discovered in 1976, it was identified as the final resting place of the queen and military general Fu Hao.][297219]} {[The artefacts unearthed within the grave included jade objects, bone objects, bronze objects etc.][297239]} {[These grave goods are confirmed by the oracle texts, which constitute almost all of the first hand written record we possess of the Shang Dynasty.][297254]} {[Below the corpse was a small pit holding the remains of six sacrificial dogs and along the edge lay the skeletons of human slaves, evidence of human sacrifice.][297280]}

{[The Terracotta Army was discovered on 29 March 1974 to the east of Xi’an in Shaanxi.][297309]} {[The terracotta soldiers were accidentally discovered when a group of local farmers was digging a well during a drought around 1.][297326]} {[6 km (1 mile) east of the Qin Emperors tomb around at Mount Li (Lishan), a region riddled with underground springs and watercourses.][297345]} {[Experts currently place the entire number of soldiers at 8,000 – with 130 chariots (130 cm long), 530 horses and 150 cavalry horses helping to ward off any dangers in the afterlife.][297372]} {[In contrast, the burial of Tutankhamun yielded six complete but dismantled chariots of unparalleled richness and sophistication.][297407]} {[Each was designed for two people (90 cm long) and had its axle sawn through to enable it to be brought along the narrow corridor into the tomb.][297425]}

{[Excavation of ancient Chinese chariots has confirmed the descriptions of them in the earliest texts.][297455]} {[Wheels were constructed from a variety of woods: elm provided the hub, rose-wood the spokes and oak the felloes.][297471]} {[The hub was drilled through to form an empty space into which the tampering axle was fitted, the whole being covered with leather to retain lubricating oil.][297490]} {[Though the number of spokes varied, a wheel by the fourth century BC usually had eighteen to thirty-two of them.][297518]} {[Records show how elaborate was the testing of each completed wheel: flotation and weighing were regarded as the best measures of balance, but even the empty spaces in the assembly were checked with millet grains.][297539]} {[One outstanding constructional asset of the ancient Chinese wheel was dishing.][297575]} {[Dishing refers to the dish-like shape of an advanced wooden wheel, which looks rather like a flat cone.][297587]} {[On occasion they chose to strengthen a dished wheel with a pair of struts running from rim to rim on each of the hub.][297604]} {[As these extra supports were inserted separately into the felloes, they would have added even greater strength to the wheel.][297627]} {[Leather wrapped up the edge of the wheel aimed to retain bronze.][297648]}

{[Within a millennium, however, Chinese chariot-makers had developed a vehicle with shafts, the precursor of the true carriage or cart.][297662]} {[This design did not make its appearance in Europe until the end of the Roman Empire.][297680]} {[Because the shafts curved upwards, and the harness pressed against a horse’s shoulders, not his neck, the shaft chariot was incredibly efficient.][297697]} {[The halberd was also part of a chariot standard weaponry.][297719]} {[This halberd usually measured well over 3 meters in length, which meant that a chariot warrior wielding it sideways could strike down the charioteer in a passing chariot.][297729]} {[The speed of the chariot which was tested on the sand was quite fast.][297756]} {[At speed these passes were very dangerous for the crews of both chariots.][297770]}

{[The advantages offered by the new chariots were not entirely missed.][297785]} {[They could see how there were literally the Warring States, whose conflicts lasted down the Qin unification of China.][297797]} {[Qin Shi Huang was buried in the most opulent tomb complex ever constructed in China, a sprawling, city-size collection of underground caverns containing everything the emperor would need for the afterlife.][297817]} {[Even a collection of terracotta armies called Terra-Cotta Warriors was buried in it.][297848]} {[The ancient Chinese, along with many cultures including ancient Egyptians, believed that items and even people buried with a person could be taken with him to the afterlife.][297861]}

questionSets.instructionHtml:
Questions 1 - 4:

Do the following statements agree with the information in Reading Passage 2?

In boxes 1-4 on your answer sheet write:

TRUE               if the statement is true

FALSE              if the statement is false

NOT GIVEN    if the information is not given in the passage

questions.text: When Tomb of Fu Hao was discovered, the written records of the grave goods proved to be accurate.
questions.explanationHtml:
TRUE

“When Tomb of Fu Hao was discovered, the written records of the grave goods proved to be accurate.”: khi lăng mộ của Fu Hao được phát hiện, những ghi chép về cổ vật trong mộ được xác thực là chính xác.

Giải thích: Những món cổ vậy trong hầm mộ được “confirmed” bởi những “oracle texts” (những ghi chép tiên tri), và những ghi chép này chiếm phần lớn số lượng văn bản viết tay (almost all of the first hand written record) thời nhà Thương.

questions.text: Human skeletons in Anyang tomb were identified as soldiers who were killed in the war.
questions.explanationHtml:
FALSE

“Human skeletons in Anyang tomb were identified as soldiers who were killed in the war.”: Xương người trong được xác định là của binh sĩ tử trận.

Giải thích: Trong bài xác định rõ luôn là xương trong lăng mộ là của “human slaves” (nô lệ) - minh chứng cho viện hiến tế người (evidence of human sacrifice).

questions.text: The Terracotta Army was discovered by people who lived nearby by chance.
questions.explanationHtml:
TRUE

“The Terracotta Army was discovered by people lived nearby by chance.”: Đội quân đất nung được tình cờ phát hiện bởi người dân sống gần đó.

Giải thích: Những chiến binh đất nung được “ACCIDENTALLY discovered” (TÌNH CỜ được phát hiện) khi một nhóm nông dân ĐỊA PHƯƠNG khi đào giếng → mình đủ thông tin để xác nhận: được phát hiện tình cờ + bởi dân sống quan khu đó

questions.text: The size of the King Tutankhamun’s tomb is bigger than that of in Qin Emperors’ tomb.
questions.explanationHtml:
NOT GIVEN

“The size of the King Tutankhamun’s tomb is bigger than that of in Qin Emperors’ tomb.”: Lăng mộ của pharaoh Tutankhamun to hơn lăng mộ của hoàng đế Tần Thủy Hoàng.

Giải thích: Thông tin duy nhất về lăng mộ của Tutankhamun là “yielded six … chariots” (khai quật được sáu cỗ xe ngựa) - không có thông tin về kích cỡ lăng mộ nên không kết luận được.

  • The room through the hub was to put a tempered axle, which is wrapped up by leather, aiming to retain 6

questions.explanationHtml:
{[

elm 

“The hub is made of wood from the tree of ___________”: Trục bánh xe được làm từ gỗ cây …

Giải thích: Bánh xe được làm từ nhiều loại gỗ (constructed from a variety of woods), trong đó ELM (gỗ du) là gỗ làm trục bánh xe

][5]}

{[

lubricating oil

“The room through the hub was to put tempered axle, which is wrapped up by leather, aiming to retain _________”: Khoảng trống giữa cái trục là để nhét thanh trục ngang đã được gia cố bằng da vào, với mục đích giữ được _______

Người ta đục lỗ cái trục bánh xe để “form an empty space” (tạo khoảng trống), là chỗ nhét cái thanh ngang (into which the axle was fitted), rồi được “covered with leather” (bọc da) để “retain LUBRICATING OIL” (giữ DẦU BÔI TRƠN).

][6]}

{[

18-32

“The number of spokes varied from ___________”: Số lượng nan hoa (căm xe) dao động từ …

Từ thế kỷ 4 TCN, số lượng nan hoa thường có từ 18 tới 32 cái

][7]}

{[

dish

“The shape of wheel resembles a ___________”: Hình dạng bánh xe có điểm tương đồng với …

Giải thích: có 2 chỗ miêu tả hình dạng bánh xe: 

1. “dish-like shape of an advanced wooden wheel”: giống với bánh xe hiện đại, có hình cái dĩa (DISH-like shape) → điền DISH.

2. “which looks rather like a flat cone”: khúc này chỉ là giải thích phần ở trên ra: mà có hình chóp nón phẳng (FLAT CONE) → không điền được vì giới hạn là CHỈ ĐIỀN MỘT TỪ.

][8]}

{[

struts

“Two___________ were used to strengthen the wheel.”: Hai cái … được dùng để gia cố bánh xe.

Giải thích: người ta gia cố bánh xe bằng “a pair of STRUTS” (một cặp THANH CHỐNG) → một cặp = hai cái → điền “struts”

][9]}

{[

bronze

“The edge of the wheel was wrapped up by leather aiming to retain ___________”: phần rìa bánh xe được quấn da để bảo quản …

questionSets.contentHtml:
• What body part of the horse had pressure released from the horse shoulder after the appearance of the shafts? 11
  • What kind of road surface did the researchers measure the speed of the chariot on? 12
  • What part of his afterlife palace was the Emperor Qin Shi Huang buried in? 13

questions.explanationHtml:
{[

neck

“What body part of the horse was released the pressure from to the horse shoulder after the appearance of the shafts?”: bộ phận nào của con ngựa giúp giảm bớt áp lực đè lên vai ngựa sau khi cái trục ra đời?

Giải thích: Nhờ cái trục được làm cong lên trên (curved upwards), và dây cương đè lên vai ngựa (pressed against the horse’s shoulders), thay vì lên CỔ (not his NECK), nên những cái trục hoạt động cực kỳ hiệu quả (hiệu quả = giảm áp lực lên cổ ngựa → kéo xe tốt hơn)

][11]}

{[

sand

“What kind of road surface did the researchers measure the speed of the chariot on?”: Những nhà nghiên cứu dùng mặt đường gì để đo vận tốc xe ngựa?

Giải thích: Người ta kiểm nghiệm vận tốc xe trên CÁT (was tested on SAND)

][12]}

{[

tomb complex

“What part of his afterlife palace was the Emperor Qin Shi Huang buried in?”: Hoàng đế Tần Thủy Hoàng được chôn cất ở khu nào trong lăng?

Giải thích: Tần Thủy Hoàng được chôn cất trong một trong những HỆ THỐNG LĂNG MỘ hoành tráng nhất (in the most opulent TOMB COMPLEX) từng được xây ở Trung Quốc → mình điền “tomb complex” thôi là đủ rồi vì nếu điền thêm “opulent” thì phải có thêm “the most” nữa → quá giới hạn từ (no more than 3 words)

][13]}

{[

neck

“What body part of the horse was released the pressure from to the horse shoulder after the appearance of the shafts?”: bộ phận nào của con ngựa giúp giảm bớt áp lực đè lên vai ngựa sau khi cái trục ra đời?

Giải thích: Nhờ cái trục được làm cong lên trên (curved upwards), và dây cương đè lên vai ngựa (pressed against the horse’s shoulders), thay vì lên CỔ (not his NECK), nên những cái trục hoạt động cực kỳ hiệu quả (hiệu quả = giảm áp lực lên cổ ngựa → kéo xe tốt hơn)

][11]}

{[

sand

“What kind of road surface did the researchers measure the speed of the chariot on?”: Những nhà nghiên cứu dùng mặt đường gì để đo vận tốc xe ngựa?

Giải thích: Người ta kiểm nghiệm vận tốc xe trên CÁT (was tested on SAND)

][12]}
